##: Portable extraction from the official Inno Setup package. Scoop's persist feature keeps the application data; the vendor setup is not executed.
description: Windows disk-space monitor that records free-space changes, storage growth, and the processes writing to disk.
post_install: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $configPath -PathType Leaf)) { throw "DiskDrift configuration file was not found: $configPath" }
notes: Scoop extracts the application files from the Inno Setup package; the vendor setup and its service-registration steps are not run.
The database and logs are stored in the Scoop persistent data directory through the standard persist mechanism.
Start the Collector from an elevated PowerShell session with: diskdrift-collector. Keep that console window open while monitoring.
Start the tray and dashboard with: diskdrift, or use the Start Menu shortcut.
The Collector requires Administrator rights for system-wide monitoring. It runs as a console process, not as a Windows service, and does not start automatically with Windows.
